out.subject: 1.4404 bar – proposal for a longer supply agreement
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the movements in your cost components. I appreciate the transparency. Those annual movements are useful context; your own order history for this part is also a practical reference for the price discussion. Please see the supporting figures below.

Our annual requirement is 23700 kg. I have attached the shared forecast so that you can assess the demand profile alongside the proposed agreement.

We propose EUR 5.07 per kg, payment at 90 days net and a contract term of 24 months, without a price adjustment clause. This retains the fixed-price structure of your offer while giving the relationship a longer contractual basis.

Please review the price on that basis, taking the documented order history and the annual requirement together. I would welcome your view on this package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Selected the prescribed longer-term fixed-price package at the available level closest to the requested opening position. Supports the price discussion with the supplier's own order history and the shared forecast, while acknowledging its cost explanation.

out.subject: Revised price proposal for 1.4404 bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing the data and taking the forecast into account. I appreciate your confirmation of the 24-month term and payment at 90 days net, notwithstanding your standard payment terms.

I understand that you require an AS-14404 clause for the longer agreement. Before settling that point, please review the fixed-price position against the additional market evidence below. It provides a more recent reference alongside the annual cost movements in your original offer.

We can revise our proposal to EUR 5.11 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and a 24-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. The shared forecast remains the basis for assessing our demand profile.

Please reconsider the fixed-price package on this basis and let me know what further movement you can make on price. I appreciate your willingness to work through the calculation with us.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

out.subject: Re: Bar pricing and contract terms
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for checking the alloy data and reflecting it in your revised offer. I also appreciate your continued agreement to payment at 90 days net and a 24-month contract.

I understand that you still require an AS-14404 clause and that you are not sharing a further breakdown of your calculation. I am not asking for confidential detail. However, the recent movement in PPI-C2431 is also relevant to the base price, since you identified it as a main cost driver. Please see the verified figures below alongside the annual movements you cited.

We can move our proposal to EUR 5.18 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and a 24-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. I recognise that the fixed-price structure remains a point of disagreement; please have your pricing committee review this revised package against the additional market evidence rather than treating that point as settled.

Please let me know what price and structure the committee can approve on this basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

out.subject: Revised fixed-price package for review
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for verifying the producer-price data and reflecting it in your revised offer. I appreciate the movement, and your continued agreement to payment at 90 days net over a 24-month term.

I note that both packages retain an AS-14404 clause and that you regard a fixed price as unfeasible. That remains the point we need to resolve; I am not asking you to reopen the data already checked.

Our revised proposal is EUR 5.17 per kg, payment at 90 days net and a 24-month contract, without a price adjustment clause. Please put this package to your pricing committee for review as a whole.

You also offered to walk us through the calculation. That would be helpful in understanding what prevents approval of a fixed-price agreement, without requiring disclosure of confidential detail. Please let me know the committee's position on this revised package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Kind regards,
